description:
Job Description: 
 In this role, you will serve as a key contributor on project and work teams, collaborating closely with developers, business partners, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions. You will execute development activities under the direction of managers and lead developers, while supporting the implementation, maintenance, and ongoing operation of assigned applications. This position is responsible for delivering reliable, scalable solutions that meet business needs and support operational excellence.

 **This is a hybrid role based in Roseville, CA and requires in office attendance on Tuesdays & Wednesdays.

 Responsibilities on a regular basis may consist of: 
 Under general supervision, responsible to: 
 Formulate and define system scope and objectives through research and fact-finding to develop or modify moderately complex information systems. 
 Prepare detailed specifications from which programs will be written. 
 Design, code, test, debug, document and maintain programs.  
 
 To be successful, you need to have: 
 Experience developing software from design specifications with minimal assistance and able to manage code in a team environment.  
 Proficient in unit testing and other quality assurance activities.   
 Competent to work on most phases of application systems analysis and programming. 
 

 Technical Skills: 
 Web application and/or service development experience, preferably with Microsoft technologies such as C#.NET, .NET Framework, .NET Core and Typescript or Javascript  
 Experience with MS SQL Server 2008 or higher  
 Troubleshooting abilities in the listed technologies  
 Experience with tools such as: source control (GIT, TFS), change control, code review, code quality and/or security scan  
 Experience designing and developing with Javascript frameworks (Angular) and the NPM ecosystem preferred  
   
 Experience to required: 2-5 years of relevant experience. 
   
 Educational Requirements : Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, information systems, or related fields; or equivalent work experience.  

 #LI-MB1 
 #Developer 
 #Roseville 
 
 The estimated pay range stated represents the typical pay range for this position or similarly employed employees or employees performing substantially similar work. Factors which may be used to determine the actual pay rate may include, but are not limited to, education, training or experience; seniority; merit and work performance; quantity or quality of production; regional differences in compensation; differences in local minimum wages, or ability and effort. 
 
 Position's Pay Range :
 
$40.00 -$45.00 
 
 
 
 Benefits may include: 
 Comprehensive medical, prescriptions, dental and vision plans

 401(k) plan with a discretionary company match

 Shareholder Purchase and Reinvestment Plan

 Basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance premium paid by the company

 Voluntary supplemental life insurance for employees, spouses and dependent children

 Fertility and Family Building Benefits

 Paid Disability benefits

 Paid time off programs

 11 Company paid holidays per year

 Flexible spending account

 Health savings account (available to High Deductible Health Plan participants only)

 Employee Assistance Program

 Educational Assistance Program

 Voluntary benefits, such as Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Accident Insurance

 Title insurance policies and certain escrow services for the employee’s primary personal residence at no charge

 Transportation benefit plan for mass transit, parking and vanpool, in several markets
